title: TRUMP_WALL + Mantequilla — terminology, origin story, formulas, and formal research meaning

short_story.summary: The names TRUMP_WALL and Mantequilla began as humor but converged unusually well with the actual architecture of the research program. TRUMP names the proof/research framework; WALL names the formal boundary currently separating detected exact symmetry from polynomial exact semantic closure; Mantequilla names the missing constructive bridge expected to cross that boundary.
humor_layer: The WALL also became a precise mathematical metaphor: symmetry can be detected, yet no polynomially bounded, exactly composable semantic interface is currently known.
Mantequilla is a reference to the South Park character Butters as 'Mantequilla' in the episode 'The Last of the Meheecans', whose story centers on crossing a border.
The running joke therefore became structurally aligned with the mathematics: TRUMP has a WALL; Mantequilla must find the passage through it.
The phrase 'the last of the Meheecans' became an informal nickname for the bridge mechanism.
short_story.canonical_joke: Why is the bridge called Mantequilla? Because TRUMP has a WALL, and somebody has to cross it.
short_story.serious_interpretation: The humor is mnemonic only. Every scientific PASS still requires exact semantics, total polynomial accounting, and independent verification.

TRUMP.meaning: The proof-carrying SAT / P-vs-NP research framework in Janus-Fundamentum.
TRUMP.scientific_status: Framework name only; not evidence for any complexity-theoretic conclusion.

TRUMP_WALL.canonical_definition: Exact symmetry is detectable, but no polynomially bounded, exactly composable semantic interface is yet known.
TRUMP_WALL.formal_shape: ExactSymmetryWitness(F,S) does not currently imply PolySizeExactSemanticClosure(F,S).
TRUMP_WALL.meaning: The unresolved boundary between detecting a genuine exact symmetry witness and exploiting it through a compact, compositional, exact, polynomially checkable semantic representation.

Detection_WALL.question: Can a genuine nontrivial exact symmetry witness S be detected and frozen?
Detection_WALL.caution: Finite detection success does not prove universal detectability.

Representation_WALL.question: Given frozen (F,S), can the induced exact existential boundary semantics be represented in polynomial size and built in polynomial time?

Composition_WALL.question: Can multiple exact local interfaces be composed without exponential product blowup?

Mantequilla.meaning: A compact exact interface object I that captures the minimally sufficient semantics crossing the boundary of the detected symmetric interior.
Mantequilla.informal_definition: Do not enumerate the whole inside; preserve exactly what must cross the boundary.
not_the_same_as: a heuristic compression with no exact equivalence proof

Hercules.meaning: Any approach that fights the WALL by doing more global work, enumerating more states, or making the detector stronger without solving the exact-interface problem.
Hercules.contrast: Hercules describes/fights the interior; Mantequilla asks what information must cross the boundary.

wall_statement.latex: \\text{Exact symmetry witness} \\not\\Rightarrow_{\\text{currently known}} \\text{poly-size exact semantic closure}
wall_statement.explanation: Finding a true symmetry does not by itself provide a polynomial-size exact closure, reconstruction path, or independently checkable certificate.

mantequilla_operator.explanation: F is the formula, S is a frozen exact symmetry witness, and I is the interface object produced after detection is sealed.

size_obligation.explanation: The interface must stay polynomial in the input size.

total_time_obligation.explanation: The full end-to-end path must remain polynomial. A cheap interface that causes exponential composition or reconstruction does not cross the WALL.

exact_semantics_obligation.explanation: The transformed/interface problem must preserve satisfiability exactly in both directions.

existential_boundary_relation.explanation: R_C is the exact joint semantics exposed by an internal region/cell C to its boundary B_C. It records which boundary assignments can be extended to a satisfying internal assignment.

representation_question.explanation: The Representation WALL asks whether the exact boundary relation has a polynomial-size exact representation computable in polynomial time.

composition_question.explanation: The Composition WALL asks whether individually compact interfaces remain compact and tractable when combined.

kclass_orbit_hint.explanation: If a binary k-variable cell is certified to have full symmetric action S_k, internal assignments fall into at most k+1 Hamming-weight orbits. This is only a coordinate hint, not by itself a sufficient boundary semantics.

representation_language_principle.statement: R_C must not be forced into an explicit truth table. Mantequilla may use a preregistered exact symbolic language L.
formal_requirements: M(F,S) belongs to a preregistered representation language L
M(F,S) is exactly equivalent to R_C
all required operations in L — build, compose, closure/solve, reconstruct, verify — remain polynomial
example_languages: BDD or related exact decision representation

information_firewall.canonical_rule: After detection, FREEZE S and run Mantequilla in a separate process with only the sealed bundle.
forbidden_after_freeze: read detector-internal artifacts outside the sealed bundle
call a SAT solver to choose or tune the bridge
materialize the full global quotient as a shortcut
information_firewall.purpose: Make 'no looking back after detection' an experimentally enforced property, not merely a declaration.

UF150.interpretation: Helped establish that symmetry detection can succeed on genuinely out-of-family structure, while formal scope remains limited.

UF250.key_signal: Nontrivial WL cells coincided with E3 generator-edge structure in the completed candidate, while closure/authority was blocked by resource/quotient-state limits.

exemplar.interpretation: A useful frozen specimen for asking whether the same exact external semantics can be represented without materializing hundreds of millions of quotient states.

UF250.restriction: UF250 is a discovery panel for Mantequilla and must not be used as an independent confirmation panel for a mechanism invented from UF250.

research_philosophy.central_question: Does detected exact symmetry induce a polynomially representable, polynomially composable exact boundary semantics?
research_philosophy.key_shift: Stop searching primarily for stronger symmetry. Search for the minimal exact semantic object that must cross the boundary.

failure_is_informative.representation_failure: The exact boundary semantics itself appears to require super-polynomial representation in the chosen language or under the permitted information model.
failure_is_informative.nonlocal_failure: Correct closure requires information not available from the frozen local/interface view.
failure_is_informative.composition_failure: Local interfaces remain small individually but their exact composition reintroduces exponential interaction.
failure_is_informative.resource_unknown: The experiment exhausted resources before the formal status could be decided.

humor_to_math_mapping.WALL: formal frontier between detection and polynomial exact closure
humor_to_math_mapping.border_crossing: transition from frozen exact symmetry witness to compact exact semantic interface
humor_to_math_mapping.last_of_the_Meheecans: informal nickname for the mechanism expected to cross the frontier
humor_to_math_mapping.note: The terminology is intentionally humorous, but every formal object and verdict is interpreted strictly.
